questions.q: How many days' journey is it from Horeb to Kadesh Barnea by Mount Seir?
questions.evidence: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea

questions.q: Which river did Yahweh tell Moses he would only see across from the top of Pisgah?
questions.evidence: for you shall not go over this Jordan

questions.q: On what did God write the ten commandments?
questions.evidence: He wrote them on two stone tablets

questions.q: "Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God." What does Moses say Yahweh is?
Where were Israel to write these words?
options: On the sand of the shore
On the walls of the temple
On the robes of the priests
On the door posts of your house
questions.evidence: You shall write them on the door posts of your house, and on your gates

questions.q: What were Israel to set aside from all the increase of their seed each year?
questions.evidence: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year

questions.q: How many times a year were all Israel's males to appear before Yahweh?
questions.evidence: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tents

questions.q: Moses said Yahweh would raise up a prophet from among Israel like whom?
questions.evidence: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me

questions.q: Moses set life and death before Israel. Which did he tell them to choose?
questions.evidence: Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants

questions.q: Moses told Israel to be strong and what?
Which mountain did Moses climb to see the promised land before he died?
questions.evidence: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho

questions.q: How old was Moses when he died?
questions.evidence: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died
